body:
Escorts visitors to Rahu planners and arranges their meetings with Yami no Majo and Yoshida.

Recorded role and choices

Osu receives the adventurers courteously, guides them to a planning council and offers help within his rank. In the August 2024 visit he introduces Yami no Majo as a venerable mage and Yoshida as a lead architect, explicitly explaining the joking Shogun title. His assistance gives the visitors access to people who can answer their questions; it does not establish that Osu rules the city or commands every Rahu institution.
